exam_name: TECHNICAL COMPETITIVE EXAMINATIONS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF INFORMATICS OFFICER - GENERAL ENGLISH PAPER - II

text_pages.text:
MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
TECHNICAL COMPETITIVE EXAMINATIONS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF
INFORMATICS OFFICER UNDER INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION
TECHNOLOGY DEPARTMENT, GOVERNMENT OF MIZORAM. FEBRUARY, 2021
GENERAL ENGLISH PAPER - II
Time Allowed : 2 hours
Full Marks : 100
All questions carry equal mark of 1 each.
Attempt all questions.
Direction (Questions No. 1 - 10) : Identify the parts of speech of the underlined words :
1. Take any magazine that you like.
(a) Pronoun
(b) Adverb
(c) Adjective
(d) Preposition
2. She went away before he came.
(a) Preposition
(b) Adverb
(c) Pronoun
(d) Conjunction
3. He cannot even see me.
(a) Adjective
(b) Adverb
(c) Verb
(d) Preposition
4. He was much loved by his wife.
(a) Preposition
(b) Pronoun
(c) Verb
(d) Conjunction
5. He conceived a master plan.
(a) Adjective
(b) Pronoun
(c) Adverb
(d) Noun
6. One would think he was mad.
(a) Verb
(b) Noun
(c) Adverb
(d) Pronoun
7. Do not back false friends.
(a) Conjunction
(b) Verb
(c) Adjective
(d) Noun
8. She fell down into the deep.
(a) Pronoun
(b) Verb
(c) Noun
(d) Adjective
9. He likes this more than that.
(a) Verb
(b) Pronoun
(c) Conjunction
(d) Adjective
10. The man was in a terrible fix.
(a) Verb
(b) Noun
(c) Adjective
(d) Adverb

- 2 -
Direction (Questions No. 11 - 20) : Fill in the blanks with appropriate prepositions.
11. There was a very serious accident __________ the roundabout.
(a) in
(b) to
(c) at
(d) from
12. In many countries people drive __________ the left.
(a) in
(b) by
(c) at
(d) on
13. To reach their village, they have to change __________ a small train at the junction.
(a) on
(b) over
(c) to
(d) into
14. There was nothing he could do __________ wait.
(a) and
(b) otherwise
(c) except
(d) than
15. If you live in a corrupt society, you cannot easily rise __________ the prevailing corruption.
(a) upon
(b) above
(c) over
(d) beyond
16. A jeep hit him while he was going __________ main road.
(a) on
(b) across
(c) through
(d) behind
17. The bridge __________ this river was built in the year 1995.
(a) above
(b) over
(c) on
(d) at
18. We hadn’t had anything to eat __________ the journey.
(a) during
(b) for
(c) since
(d) while
19. He is quick __________ solving questions.
(a) in
(b) with
(c) at
(d) about
20. We must not fight __________ our friends.
(a) against
(b) over
(c) with
(d) for

Direction (Questions No. 31 - 40) : Choose the correct modal to fill in the blanks.
31. Why __________ we go out for dinner tonight?
(a) shall
(b) don’t
(c) do
(d) are
32. I __________ met him for lunch had I known he was coming.
(a) would
(b) had
(c) would have
(d) will
33. He __________ passed easily if only he had spent a bit more time revising.
(a) could have
(b) must have
(c) would have
(d) might have
34. She went to get flowers, she __________ be here in a minute.
(a) could
(b) must
(c) might
(d) should
35. __________ you learn anything?
(a) Hadn’t
(b) Didn’t
(c) Weren’t
(d) Haven’t
36. Although we didn’t have the right tools, we __________ get the work finished on time.
(a) could have
(b) were able to
(c) could
(d) managed to

- 4 -
37. She __________ to lunch, she usually goes at this time.
(a) should have gone
(b) must go
(c) must have gone
(d) should go
38. It __________ be ready by Friday, if we don’t have any unexpected problems.
(a) should
(b) may
(c) must
(d) might
39. Peter __________ waiting long when she arrived.
(a) hadn’t been
(b) wasn’t
(c) hasn’t been
(d) won’t be
40. It was her birthday yesterday, we __________ got her a card.
(a) should have
(b) had to
(c) should
(d) must have

Direction (Questions No. 71 - 80) : Choose the correct pair of words to fill in the blanks.
71. The Deputy Manager __________ to resign because all his proposals were __________ down by
his superiors.
(a) planned, thrown
(b) threatened, turned
(c) began, kept
(d) began, kept
72. She was not __________ by the criticism and paid no __________ even when her best friend
talked against her.
(a) bothered, attention
(b) shaken, indication
(c) threatened, warning
(d) troubled, brain
73. Children are more __________ than adults, it is __________ their quickness in learning a new
language.
(a) intelligent, disproved by
(b) adaptable, reflected in
(c) conservative, seen in
(d) susceptible, demonstrated in
74. Mary’s__________ in athletics yielded rich __________ she got a scholarship.
(a) performance, money
(b) defeat, results
(c) behavior, appreciation
(d) excellence, dividends

- 7 -
75. I am not __________ to sell you my house unless you offer a more __________ price.
(a) agree, better
(b) ready, correct
(c) prepared, realistic
(d) having, actual
76. Due to __________ rainfall this year, there will be __________ cut in water supply.
(a) scanty, substantial
(b) surplus, abundant
(c) meagre, least
(d) abundant, considerable
77. We __________ him with many promises, but nothing would __________ him.
(a) tempted, influence
(b) attracted, fascinate
(c) provoked, desiccate
(d) gave, deprive
78. In his __________, he followed the __________ course.
(a) agony, appropriate
(b) hurry, diversified
(c) ignorance, wrong
(d) predicament, proper
79. The construction of the hall has been __________ because of the __________ of cement in the market.
(a) held, non-availability
(b) denied, restrictions
(c) hampered, shortage
(d) prevented, supply
80. Only when __________ failed, the police resorted to __________.
(a) efforts, power
(b) power, punishment
(c) arrests, imprisonment
(d) persuasions, force
Direction (Questions No. 81 - 85) : Complete the common proverbs using the given options.

(b) thought
(c) wife
(d) name

(c) air
(d) wind

(c) master
(d) workshop

(b) pot
(c) vessel
(d) bowl

(c) with equal place
(d) on the first impression
Direction (Questions No. 91 - 100) : Fill in the blanks using the correct alternative.
91. Many companies see technology as a __________ for a whole host of business problems.
(a) consideration
(b) linking
(c) preference
(d) panacea
92. The judge acquitted the prisoner __________ the charge of murder.
(a) from
(b) of
(c) with
(d) about
93. You must __________ your house in order before you offer advice to others.
(a) get
(b) arrange
(c) bring
(d) organize
94. His rustic behavior was an embarrassment to the __________ sensibility of the young ladies.
(a) fragile
(b) soft
(c) delicate
(d) sober
95. Robert is too __________ as far as his food habits are concerned.
(a) enjoyable
(b) curious
(c) fastidious
(d) interesting
96. The soldiers were instructed to __________ restraint and handle the situation peacefully.
(a) exercise
(b) enforce
(c) control
(d) remain
97. It was __________ hot that day and the cable suffered the brunt of the heat.
(a) treacherously
(b) unfailingly
(c) acceptably
(d) unbelievably
98. As the waves rose the ship tossed, many of the passengers felt __________.
(a) lethargic
(b) queasy
(c) subdued
(d) tremulous
99. Having lived a __________ life for forty years, he is not able to take any independent decision.
(a) safe
(b) happy
(c) cloistered
(d) successful
100. His approach to work is so __________ that none of his colleagues consider him dependable.
(a) uninterestingly
(b) common
(c) low
(d) casual
